about: The format registry of plan 24a UC02: every definition and file format with a version the code declares. scripts/check_formats.py fails when the code declares another version than 'current' (a bump without an entry) and when a file of a frozen format changed (sha256). An open format records no hashes. 'Published definition' (definition_version.format, per kind) and the management API / compatibility generation of the 24a table are not file formats with a schema and are not listed.

formats.title: DbDataStore entity model (schemaVersion)
formats.note: gains cache and checks; open until the first release that holds either (24a D5)

formats.title: Serving data source (a connection file, schema: connection/N)
formats.note: gains cache and checks, and grants (22a GP03: who may read the data source, part of the published definition; the serving policy a definition carries is the existing `extensions.gateway`, so plan 13c D19 adds no key and no version); open until the first release that holds any of them (24a D5). Sync's second login (plan 28c E20: `extensions.sync.run_user`, `extensions.sync.run_password_secret`) is two optional keys of Sync's own extension block, additive: a file from before loads as it did, a misspelled key is refused with file and line, and no version number moves

formats.title: App view spec (a file under views, schemaVersion)
formats.note: new with GP06; a newer one is refused naming kind, file, app and both numbers

formats.title: Views dashboard (a file, schema: dashboard/N; one number with the shared core and the other kind)
formats.note: new with plan 32 (DBR02); one number, ViewsFormat.Current, for dashboard and report and the widget vocabulary of the shared core: a new widget type, query form, layout type or selector condition bumps both; a newer one is refused naming kind, file and both numbers. Open until the first release that holds either (24a D5)

formats.title: Views report (a file, schema: report/N; one number with the shared core and the other kind)
formats.note: new with plan 32 (DBR02); one number, ViewsFormat.Current, for dashboard and report and the widget vocabulary of the shared core: a new widget type, query form, layout type or selector condition bumps both; a newer one is refused naming kind, file and both numbers. Open until the first release that holds either (24a D5)

formats.title: Semantic package (the catalog, format of the semantic-model definition)
formats.note: gains cache and checks; open until the first release that holds either (24a D5)

formats.title: Build model file (a model's .yml, schemaVersion)
formats.note: gains checks (23a FQ02); format 1 has no schemaVersion; open until the first release that holds checks (24a D5)

formats.title: Sync replication file (task.yaml, schemaVersion)
formats.note: gains the checks section (plan 23a FQ04); open until the first release that holds it (24a D5). CW01 adds no key and no version: `changeProcessing.writer` may be left out (the default for the reader is named when the file is read: ChangeApply behind an incremental reader, DeleteInsert behind a reload reader) and the writer kind `ChangeApply` is a new value of an existing key; an older Sync reads a file that names it and fails the run naming the unknown writer kind, and a file without a writer is not readable by it

formats.title: Sync table-mapping file (schemaVersion)
formats.note: unchanged by FQ04; one entry per Sync file kind because each has its own version

formats.title: Sync script manifest (schemaVersion)
formats.note: unchanged by FQ04; one entry per Sync file kind because each has its own version

formats.title: Runner package manifest (schema: package/N)
formats.note: frozen by its release; the strict reader is its definition

formats.title: Release manifest (schema: release/N, the staged release of an upgrade)
formats.note: plan 24a UC09: the server stages the release it checked as a release/1 manifest, signed with its own key, and the helper that swaps the program checks it again (the shelved updater's format, used as code); its schemaVersions carry the compatibility generation

formats.title: Upgrade journal (schema: update-plan/N, updates/update-plan.json in the upgrade area beside the program)
formats.note: plan 24a UC09: the journal of one upgrade, written by the server and moved on by the helper, read by the status endpoint; a journal of another schema is refused with its file named (PlanStore.Load)
